lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in approximately five discernible horizontal rows; blobs exhibit consistent inter-node spacing of roughly 1.5 to 2 diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with blob columns, forming distinct nodal anchors across the mid-lateral flank.
